## Design

### 2026-10-05 — Today I finalized my thoughts for my custom PCB. I am going to make a board that is able to capture IR signals sent from a toy laser gun, translate them, and then out put a master signal to manipulate

**1h**

Today I finalized my thoughts for my custom PCB. I am going to make a board that is able to capture IR signals sent from a toy laser gun, translate them, and then out put a master signal to manipulate the score.

I am going to use an ESP32 as the microcontroller, and some IR leds for signal capture and transmission.

I spent a while editing my idea reel to hopefully gain some traction on youtube.

I also designed a logo for my project, Operation M.I.M.I.C.
